title: A Compass for the Rivergate
author: Mirabel Zhou
blurb: Zephyrine Halloran, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
